summary: gh plate pr create accepts --base (defaulting to the configured integration base) and rejects duplicate --base with passthrough after --.
migration_impact: Agents may use `gh plate pr create --body-file … --labels Feature,area:cli` without spelling `--base`; explicit override via flag or `gh plate pr create -- --base …` still works.
agent_notes: Do not pass --base both as a plate flag and after `--`. Run `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_pr_preflight.PrCreateBaseTests` for regression.
